description: This Java class implements the GLAccountReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve and manage General Ledger (GL) accounts, including fetching account lists, details by ID, and lookup data. It interacts with a database via JDBC, mapping SQL query results to GLAccountData objects, and includes support for filtering and association parameters.

classes.name: GLAccountMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation that maps SQL result set rows to GLAccountData objects, including account details, classifications, usage, and optional running balance.

classes.name: GLAccountDataLookUpMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation that maps SQL result set rows to GLAccountDataForLookup objects for account lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveAllGLAccounts
methods.description: Fetches a list of GL accounts based on various optional filter parameters such as classification, search term, usage, manual transaction allowance, and disabled status, possibly including running balances.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific GL account identified by its ID, considering association parameters and including the latest journal entry if requested.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledDetailGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled GL accounts of the 'Detail' usage type for a given account classification, or all if no classification is specified.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledDetailGLAccounts
methods.description: Overload to retrieve all enabled Detail GL accounts without filtering by account type.

methods.name: retrieveNewGLAccountDetails
methods.description: Provides default values and template data for creating a new GL account of a specific type.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledHeaderGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled GL accounts of the 'Header' usage type for a specified account classification.

methods.name: retrieveAccountsByTagId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GL account data for accounts associated with a specific rule ID and transaction type, for use in lookup scenarios.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Generates the SQL SELECT schema string used for mapping database rows to GLAccountData objects.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a single row of the ResultSet to a GLAccountData instance; used within RowMapper implementations.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a single row of the ResultSet to a GLAccountDataForLookup instance; used for account lookup query results.
